'''Esther Barrugués Alviñá''' (born 16 May 1980) is an Andorran [[Shooting sport|sports shooter]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.olympicchannel.com/en/athletes/detail/esther-barrugues-alvina/|title=Esther BARRUGUES ALVINA|website=Olympic Channel|access-date=2020-03-02|archive-date=2 March 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200302043127/https://www.olympicchannel.com/en/athletes/detail/esther-barrugues-alvina/|url-status=live}}</ref> She competed in the [[Shooting at the 2016 Summer Olympics – Women's 10 metre air rifle|women's 10 metre air rifle]] event at the [[2016 Summer Olympics]] where she finished in 51st place.<ref name="Bio">{{cite web|url=https://www.rio2016.com/en/athlete/esther-barrugues-alvina |title=Esther Barrugues Alvina |access-date=6 August 2016 |work=Rio 2016 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160806061639/https://www.rio2016.com/en/athlete/esther-barrugues-alvina |archive-date= 6 August 2016 }}</ref>
